analysis.headline: Summary names the customer's new employer (Cedar Lane Distribution), breaching privacy redaction, and wrongly says no DPA was stated when name and postcode were taken (DOB was not).

claims.explanation: Only name and postcode were verified; no DOB was asked, so full DPA was not completed and the rule wording applies.

evidence.quote: Can you give me your name and postcode so I can locate the account?
Luke Webb, FK7 3WX.

claims.text: The customer called the company and arrears were discussed.
claims.explanation: Customer opened by asking about their account via a general service greeting; the agent mentioned arrears without stating amounts.

evidence.quote: How can I help?
There is one missed instalment and arrears showing.

claims.text: A week between jobs reduced income, and the first wage payment from Cedar Lane Distribution will cover only part of a month.
claims.explanation: Facts are correct (week between jobs, smaller first pay), but the employer name must be redacted, e.g. 'new employer'.

evidence.quote: I work for Cedar Lane Distribution now.
Smaller.

claims.text: An I&E assessment was planned and the agent checked the customer's understanding;
claims.explanation: The I&E was planned for the call on the 28th (T15). The agent did ask the customer to confirm the next step and confirmed it was correct (T23-T25), which is arguably an understanding check, but this is an interpretation for the reviewer to check.

evidence.quote: We can also complete an income and expenditure assessment on that call
Can you confirm the next step?
That's correct.

claims.explanation: Agent said the £80 guess would not be recorded as a promise; the customer chose to wait for the payslip.

evidence.quote: We won't record that as a payment promise.

claims.text: The next steps are for the customer to prepare income and essential expense figures and call on 28 October after work to agree an affordable arrangement.
claims.explanation: The customer will gather payslip and bill figures and ring on the 28th after work; 28th falls in October given the call date of 20 October.
